summary: FS Credit Opportunities Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its reconvened Annual Meeting on September 8, 2026 again lacked a quorum of preferred stockholders, so the election of Class I director nominee Barbara J. Fouss remains pending and the meeting was adjourned to September 24, 2026 at the company's Philadelphia offices. Walter W. Buckley, III was previously elected. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisor is stated. This is a routine meeting adjournment notice, not a special situation; watch only the reconvened vote outcome and any preferred-holder governance friction.
